would like to make an official complaint with regards to my medical care over the last ten years but especially over the last year.

Let me begin with my asthma care, prior to covid, I received no annual review for around five years or any interest or care shown.

During the Covid period Framlingham Surgery all of a sudden appeared concerned that my breathing had deteriorated due to the regularity of my prescription request (which was no different to previous years).

My appointment was by telephone and I was advised by the Asthma nurse that they were very concerned and i would receive a call the following week and then every two weeks. I received only one call and then once again forgotton about. In 2024/2025 I received a letter again requesting a review, which I was then made aware for the first time that regular use of my Salamol inhaler would increase my chances of developing COPD, despite being asthmatic for over 30 years.

My second concern is my lack of care in 2025.

Despite trying to garner a Doctor's appointment in late April/May, your receptionists palmed me off with a Nurse Practitioner, despite my breathing having deteriorated, whilst I was only getting two hours sleep a night, due to Restless leg issue, which became unbearable. I was subsequently told to increase my Sertraline intake.

In the first two week's of May, I tried to garner a Doctor's appointment and stressed the seriousness of my symptoms (swelling of both legs, unable to eat more than two mouthfulls of food without vomiting, a temperature and being Jaundice) but still failed to be able to see a Doctor, again your receptionists decided that I wasn't sick enough to see a Doctor so a Paramedic appointment was granted.

The Paramedic failed to do any observations, didn't pick up how Jaundice I was and the only advice given was to go to the Pharmacy and buy some anti-sickness tablets.

One day later I was so ill I went to A & E where I was advised that I would have died if I hadn't made the decision to attend hospital that day as my organs were shutting down.

Subsequently, I had a three month stay in Hospital of which I can not remember any of the next few weeks, I was then advised that I only had 2-4 months to live back in June 2025 and diagnosed with severe heart failure.

Thankfully St Bartholomew's hospital have been superb and given me an extended life, however, my prognosis is still not favourable.

Since I have left hospital Framlingham Surgery have still failed to give me the care required, firstly, I have been bombarded with emails stating I am overdue for a review of my medication , despite attending the surgery to make an appointment in September and being advised that the earliest appointment is in December, which I find very hard to believe when I know at least two people who have received earlier dates. Due to this I have had two items on my repeat prescription stopped without prior notice, which is an absolute disgrace when it is your fault that I cannot have my review.
I also requirement an ECG prior to my operation in October, again not forfilled.

I attempted to put accross my concerns in August 2025 with Dr Turner but this was not taken seriously.

Quite frankly I am digusted with Framlingham Medical practice shortcomings, it could have resulted in my death in May 2025, however, my life expectancy and quality of life have been majorally impacted.

Finally, due to my balance issues, I had a fall and ruptured my Achilles tendon ligaments, this was confirmed by the Surgery’s Paramedic, he advised me that he will process a referral for physiotherapy, been waiting three months and heard nothing!

Appalling patient care from the over aggressive receptionists, the Paramedics failings and the non visible
